comment: The agent manifest. A static host cannot list a directory, so this file IS the directory listing: add a folder under public/agents/ and add its name here, or the app will never fetch it. Two entries, and the second is not a copy of a stage of the first. `main` is the agent this page talks to, and it walks a `critique` stage: the same model, in the same window, reading back a turn it still believes in, producing prose for the person. `critic` is a different job — a separate Worker with a separate prompt that never saw the conversation, whose first line is read MECHANICALLY (crates/agent/src/critic.rs), and whose non-pass stops the turn reporting itself as answered. The stage improves the ANSWER and cannot gate it; the agent gates it and cannot improve it. A model marking its own homework is not a gate, for the same reason crates/agent/src/passes.rs never asks a model whether it is finished. Compaction is neither of them: it builds its own sheet (crates/agent/src/window.rs) and needs no agent at all.
